name: Rip Curl
band_note: core tee $27 and core blouse $45 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Surf brand making wetsuits, boardshorts, bikinis around $55 a piece, fleece and surf watches for women and men, sold through its own stores, site and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in Torquay, Australia in 1969 by Doug Warbrick; Brian Singer.

quote.q: Rip Curl remains a company built by surfers for surfers, and we’ve been market leaders in surfing for over 50 years.

Outlets (8): Cabazon, San Diego Outlet (Linda Vista Rd), Trestles Outlet, Santa Ana Outlet, Santa Cruz Outlet, Camarillo (630 Ventura Blvd = Camarillo Premium Outlets; locator name has no 'outlet'), Waikele Outlet, Kapolei Outlet. San Diego/Trestles/Santa Ana/Santa Cruz 'Outlet' doors are standalone streets the brand calls outlets. Locator setting max_results 26 but 30 rendered — list appears complete for US. Heavily Hawaii (11) + California (14).
